repeated_compliance_vector_frequency.note: generate_compliance_vector keys on (scenario NAME, seed), so the same seed gives DIFFERENT vectors in S1/S2/S3; 'seed' is not a latent shared across scenarios.

shared_rollouts: The GLOBAL row at ticks 0/5/10 of one trajectory is the same heuristic reference trajectory re-simulated (see target_generation_audit.structure for identical-outcome counts).
grouping_hierarchy: trajectory = (scenario, seed): one hidden compliance vector + one heuristic reference trajectory
minimum_split_unit: trajectory (scenario, seed): every tick and every candidate row of a trajectory in the same split. A random row split places the same state (2 to 56 candidate rows) and the shared GLOBAL rollout in both train and test.
recommended_split_unit: seed index assigned identically in every scenario (seed k in the same split in S1, S2, S3), plus explicit cell / template hold-outs for generalization tests.
